[RTCT.7.2] **Breach semantics, for a cap decided on a count the engine
holds.** The breach returns `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_BREACH` from the API call that
triggered the check. The engine MUST NOT mutate state on a breaching
call (the assert / push / fire / append does not happen).
Subsequent calls work normally — the engine is not
"poisoned" — but the operation that breached is rejected.

**Ten of [RTCT.7.1]'s eleven caps are that shape.** `pump_wcet_ns` is not: it
is decided on a measurement taken after the work has already happened, so there
is no operation left to refuse and no intact state to carry forward. It halts
the tier ([RTCT.7.3]).
